messages:
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: llm-routing v2.3.1 -> starting canary in 3m. Feature-flag plan: llmroute_prefetch = 5% -> 20% over 45m. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/deploys/1768889990 . @nisha @tom

nisha: quick note — staging replay showed 12% higher p99 on a small tail. not catastrophic but above our gating threshold. holding ramp until QA verifies.

tom: can we keep flag at 0% for now? prefer to add a warmup prefetch in rollout config first.

deploy-bot: Current rollout state: queued. Feature flags default=0% for canaries unless manually overridden.

ops-ash: manually set llmroute_prefetch=0% in canaries and paused deploy automation. logged: "pause - investigate p99 tail" :pause_button:

qa-lin: running focused cold-start tests against v2.3.1 (with full trace capture). will post a short summary in ~15m.

tom: drafting quick warmup tweak — add a prefetch=3 requests per replica during startup and extend kv-cache-seed to 10s. Could be done as rollout config change.
nisha: if warmup fixes it we should do a conservative ramp: 1% -> 3% -> 7% -> 15% over 3h with strict p99 alerts. keep rollback command handy.

release-mgr: please prepare a release-note blurb so PMs are aware of pause and plan. also need the pin command in case we rollback.

tom: rollback/pin runbook snippet:
```
# pin to previous stable version
redwoodctl route pin --service llm-routing --version v2.3.0 --reason "canary p99 regressed"
# abort queued rollout
redwoodctl deploy abort --id 1768889990
```

ops-ash: added release-note: "Canary paused: v2.3.1 ramp deferred pending cold-start warmup fix. No customer impact." Pinged PM and support.

qa-lin: test results: 3/120 replay traces show 2.5x token latency spikes during cold-start windows. attached sample traces and timeline.

tom: looks like the new batcher and cold KV population. propose we: 1) add startup prefetch + extend cache-seed, 2) re-run replay in staging, 3) if stable, resume with tiny ramp (1% -> 5% over 90m) with tight SLOs.
nisha: agreed. add an automatic safety gate: abort ramp if p99 > baseline + 8% for 10m. ops-ash can you configure that?

ops-ash: safety gate added to the rollout policy, p99 alert rule created, canary remains paused. recorded in ticket. :white_check_mark:

release-mgr: release note updated with mitigation plan and expected timeline. will notify PM after staging signoff.

qa-lin: re-run smoke with warmup tweak scheduled in 20m. will post pass/fail.

deploy-bot: queued canary resumed only after manual resume. Automation hold retained. Logs/artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/deploys/1768889990/records

nisha: if smoke passes, manual resume steps: 1) set llmroute_prefetch=1% via console 2) observe for 15m 3) increment per plan. keep rollback command ready.

tom: will push the rollout-config change now to staging, will paste configs after run.

qa-lin: smoke completed — warmup tweak reduced cold-start spikes to baseline +/-2%. recommend proceed with conservative ramp.

nisha: ok to resume. @ops-ash can you kick the manual resume and start ramp: 1% -> 5% over 90m with gate?

ops-ash: manual resume initiated. flag set to 1% for canary. monitoring on. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Resume recorded by ops-ash. Canary progressing: 1% -> scheduled increments. Automated abort if safety gate trips.

release-mgr: updated release notes: "Canary resumed with warmup prefetch; conservative ramp and safety gates in place. Monitoring active." Notifying stakeholders.

nisha: thanks team. thread will stay open for final confirmation after ramp completes. please post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
